source: ST-ZXNAME0000XZ also found that specialization depended on context. Its analysis reports specialization patterns in encoder experts while decoder experts did not exhibit the same clear behavior, and multilingual specialization did not reduce to simple “one language per expert” partitions.
zh: ST-ZXNAME0000XZ 还发现专业化取决于上下文。它的分析报告了编码器专家的专业化模式，而解码器专家没有表现出同样清晰的行为，并且多语言专业化并没有简化为简单的“每个专家一种语言”分区。
